Odisha Governor's 'Work for BJP' Remark Sparks Row

Odisha Governor Raghubar Das's statement that he would "work to strengthen the BJP" has triggered a political controversy. The Biju Janata Dal (BJD) expressed shock and condemned the remark. The Congress party has demanded the Governor's recall. The Governor's statement was made after his appointment.
